comparison.objective: Install a spin-on oil filter to gasket contact, then tighten it by the specified fractional turn.
comparison.physical_skill: Thread-start alignment, broad cylindrical rotation, contact detection, and bounded hand tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Gasket seated and filter advanced roughly three-quarters to one turn without cross-threading, looseness, or overtightening.
comparison.reason: This record tests threaded component installation and contact-relative angular tightening. The candidate neither installs its damper nor uses final fastener angle as the outcome; it adjusts damping and proves stopping behavior across physical cycles.
